summary: Confirmed: $25 electric (30/50A), ~90 sites, FCFS only, paid at the golf pro shop or City Hall (not a booking channel), 14-night max at daily/weekly rates. Season now 03-28..10-31 from the page (was approximate 03-20). Lakeview confirmed (lake ~20-24 ha); shoreline pads may earn lakefront - flagged. Seasonal passes marketed - long-stay flag.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview): confirmed at least lakeview, possibly understated. Shelbina Lake is ~20-24 ha by imagery (well over the 5-acre pond line). On summer imagery a row of RVs on the east shore (around 39.7200,-92.0425) is parked ~10-20 m from the water with grass and scattered trees between and no road; another pad sits on a small point at ~39.7245,-92.0425 a few metres from the shore. Those could earn lakefront under the open-apron rule, but I could not confirm the apron is open (tree fringe in places, no ground photo), so per unsure-downgrade I leave lakeview. AWH call on lakefront. The dam is at the lake's south end; the camping is on the lake side.

LONG-STAY: the city sells a 28-day pass ($400) and a season pass ($1,400, Mar 28-Oct 31) on 'designated sites only', with mowing and air-conditioner rules for pass holders. A nightly rate is posted ($25) and every site is FCFS, but how many of the ~90 sites are seasonal designated sites is not stated. Summer imagery shows ~25-30 RVs across the east-shore loops, typical of mixed use; I can't tell seasonal from nightly. AWH call on the five tests.
Payment: the golf course pro shop or City Hall is where fees are paid, not a booking channel - reservations are not accepted at all (booking.reservable false, fcfs always confirmed).
Water/sewer at site: not stated (only a $2 dump fee); left unknown.
Pin 39.7220,-92.0410 sits on the middle east-shore camping loop - fine.
